## 1. Exact objects and precision

Use every original p=13 or19 mod24, p=6m+1 with literal m>=2,
n=2m, N=3m=(p-1)/2 and c=1/2. Work in F_p with the complete
finite source h(z)=sum_(k=0)^m q_k z^k,

 q_k=(-1)^k binom(m,k)binom(3m-k,m),

 rho=x(4x-3)^2, S(r)=4r^3-3r,
 H=h(rho), H(r^2)=P_n(S(r)),
 Hb=g(1+x^N)+(s0/5)(4x+x^(N-1)).

The fixed source facts are H(0)=H_N=g, H(1)=1, H(c)=0. Thus

 Q(x)=(H-Hb)/(1-x),    deg Q<=N-2,
 L=ell(T)=3Y=I_x[(4x^N-2)Q(x)](c).                 (A1)

particular stated degree window. g is fixed and a unit, not a freely
chosen baseline. s0 and the endpoint/response quantities may be zero.

## 2. The known prefix kernel is retained

Write Q=sum_(l=0)^(N-2) Q_l x^l. Every divisor l+1 and N+l+1 is a
p-unit, since l+1<=N-1 and N+l+1<=p-2. At the actual endpoint,
c^N=-1, so direct coefficient pairing gives

 L=-sum_l Q_l c^(l+1) [2/(l+1)+8/(2l+1)].            (A2)

N=-1/2 has only been used in scalar derivative/denominator coefficients;
literal exponents and bounds remain integers. The factor 2l+1 is at
most p-4 and is nonzero. This is the very same kernel as the old prefix

 beta_N=sum_(j=1)^N [2/j+8/(2j-1)] c^j,
 b0=(12+beta_N)/5.                                 (A3)

It is not an independent evaluated constraint on the source. Computing all
Q_l or all T coefficients is not part of this component.

## 3. Integrate before using r^p=-r at the endpoint

Let alpha^2=c in F_p2; alpha^p=-alpha, zeta=S(alpha)=-alpha. Define

 U(r)=I_r[Q(r^2)],       V(x)=I_x[Q(x)].

U is odd of degree<=p-4, while V has degree<=N-1. Consequently

 F(r)=8r^p U(r)-2V(r^2)                             (A4)

is even, zero-origin and degree<=2p-4, and

 F'=(8r^p-4r)Q(r^2).

The original pulled-back target primitive has exactly the same derivative,
origin, even parity and degree bound. Their difference is a0+a1*r^p;
even parity removes a1 and the origin removes a0. Thus

 L=-8alpha U(alpha)-2V(c).                          (A5)

Equivalently, from V(r^2)=2rU(r)-2I_r U(r),

 L=-12alpha U(alpha)+4I_r U(alpha).                 (A6)

This last formula contains the weight-derivative correction. Replacing
8r^p-4r by its endpoint value -12alpha BEFORE taking a primitive would
erase 4I_r U(alpha) and has not been justified. We do not assert that the
correction is nonzero at every alpha; no such claim is needed. All terms
descend to F_p: U(alpha) is anti-invariant and alpha U(alpha) is invariant;
I_r U is even. This is finite polynomial reasoning, not an analytic path.
